Companion Animal Travel Desk Operations
This section sets the immediate handling rules for animal bookings, carrier acceptance, welfare review, and transfer control at Aurelia Skyways.

All staff shall treat each animal booking as a priority task and confirm the travel file before any acceptance is endorsed. The welfare coordinator must review comfort, ventilation, restraint, and visible signs of distress before release to the ground team. If a carrier is damaged, overcrowded, wet, or poorly secured, the desk must stop processing at once and obtain a corrected submission.

For cat bookings, <<FACT F055>> The desk must then verify the traveler record, crate condition, and accompanying documents without delay. For small dog bookings, <<FACT F062>> Staff must not rely on verbal assurances when the measured allowance is unclear, and the carrier must remain closed until cleared by the supervisor.

Reptile travel requires strict age verification, clean containment, and an immediate welfare check before acceptance. <<FACT F078>> Any doubt about age, species handling, or enclosure safety must be escalated before the animal is accepted. The ground team shall move all carriers carefully between services, avoid heat exposure, and keep the animal away from loud congestion or rough stacking.

If the traveler is delayed, the desk shall hold the file open and maintain control of the carrier until the next authorized action is given. The senior coordinator must be informed of any welfare concern, missing declaration, or unsafe handoff without hesitation.

Contact the senior coordinator or the duty manager for immediate escalation and release approval.
